description: This Java source file defines an abstract fragment class for browsing and managing add-ons within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles UI components, user interactions, and integration with add-on factories, supporting single and multiple selection modes, drag-and-drop reordering, and search functionality.

classes.name: KeyboardAddOnViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual add-on items, managing UI components and user interactions for each add-on.

classes.name: DemoKeyboardAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing the list of add-ons and search view within the fragment.

methods.name: createItemTouchCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback for handling drag-and-drop reordering of add-ons.

methods.name: getAddOnFactory
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the add-on factory instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, validating factory type and setting column count.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and initializes search controller if needed.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as dismissing the search controller.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up RecyclerView, layout manager, adapter, and demo keyboard view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu options and sets visibility based on search and tweaks options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for tweaks and search.

methods.name: onTweaksOptionSelected
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to handle tweaks option selection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Loads add-ons, updates UI, and applies current add-on to demo view.

methods.name: createLayoutManager
methods.description: Creates a grid layout manager with span size lookup for add-on items.

methods.name: applyAddOnToDemoKeyboardView
methods.description: Abstract method for applying an add-on to the demo keyboard view.

methods.name: getMarketSearchKeyword
methods.description: Abstract method to get the search keyword for market search.

methods.name: getMarketSearchTitle
methods.description: Abstract method to get the title resource ID for market search.
